name: phasewell-scope
features: Dual channel scope compares a local song file against the microphone.
Views switch between overlay, split, X-Y, difference, spectrum, waterfall, radial and correlation.
Offset, residual and match readouts update live, with align now, auto track and reset trim.
A YouTube video loads as a source with match file time.
Trigger, auto level and freeze controls work.
overlap: Older version of scope-listener. Merge candidate.
